consumer: A frontend/engine possession check asking 'does the avatar have a knife_combat?', the same yes/no an engine condition/mission/dialogue eligibility check consumes.
scope: A possession predicate over everything the engine counts as carried, including items nested inside worn/wielded containers (holsters, sheaths, bags), not just the flat on-person top-level lists.
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_carried_items, which enumerates only ctx.u.wielded_items(), ctx.u.worn, and ctx.u.inv_const_slice() top-level stacks and never recurses into container contents, forcing the frontend to re-derive the yes/no from a partial item view rather than reading the engine's own possession result.
divergence: A knife_combat sheathed inside a worn holster/container: the engine's possession predicate (which recurses into contents) reports carrying=true, but the flat dump emits only the holster and omits the nested knife, so the re-derived answer is wrongly 'not carrying'.
